headline: Inflation Fears Drive Market Sell-Off; Semis Decline Amid AI Warnings and Geopolitical Tensions
summary: The week was dominated by persistent inflation concerns, with hotter-than-expected CPI and PPI data reigniting fears of Fed rate hikes and pushing Treasury yields to 5%. This macro backdrop triggered broad market sell-offs, particularly impacting semiconductor stocks which saw significant declines. Geopolitical tensions, including a surge in oil prices and debate over US policy, added to market uncertainty, while AI chip advancements and supply chain pressures continued to shape the tech sector.

themes.label: Fed / Rates / Macro
themes.narrative: Hotter-than-expected CPI and PPI data signaled persistent inflation, leading to market sell-offs and renewed concerns over Fed rate hikes. Treasury yields surged to 5%, with Fed officials offering a mixed outlook despite Warsh signaling a steady approach.

themes.label: US Semis / AI Chips
themes.narrative: Semiconductor stocks experienced sharp declines, with some falling over 5%, amid warnings about AI investing and broader market uncertainty. Despite this, TSMC projected significant revenue growth and expanded advanced node capacity for AI chips, while Nvidia explored further AI startup investments.

themes.label: China / Tariffs / Geopolitics
themes.narrative: Geopolitical tensions escalated, driving oil prices to $110 on Middle East concerns. China continued its advancements in memory chips, challenging competitors, while also seeking to de-escalate trade friction with the EU.

themes.label: Trump 2.0 / US Policy
themes.narrative: Trump's proposed diesel deal with Russia faced significant political opposition, with House Republicans moving to block the agreement. This highlighted ongoing debates over US energy policy and international relations.

themes.label: Earnings / Guidance
themes.narrative: Anthropic reported a significant revenue surge, signaling strong performance ahead of its anticipated IPO. This provided a positive counterpoint amidst broader market caution.

themes.label: Software / Internet / Platforms
themes.narrative: Jio Platforms pursued India's largest IPO with a $106 billion valuation, reflecting strong growth in emerging market digital infrastructure. SpaceX continued its aggressive vertical integration in datacenter infrastructure and optical fiber development.
